mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, union_id, employee_id, tenant_key FROM t_auth_external_identity WHERE provider = 'FEISHU' AND provider_subject = #{providerSubject} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, union_id, employee_id, tenant_key FROM t_auth_external_identity WHERE provider = 'FEISHU' ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_external_identity ( user_id, provider, provider_subject, union_id, employee_id, tenant_key, last_login_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerSubject}, #{unionId}, #{employeeId}, #{tenantKey}, NOW(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_auth_external_identity SET union_id = #{unionId}, employee_id = #{employeeId}, tenant_key = #{tenantKey}, last_login_at = NOW(3) WHERE provider = 'FEISHU' AND provider_subject = #{providerSubject}
